review_candidates.title: Head of Total Rewards
review_candidates.description: About the role GoGlobal is strengthening its global People capability. We are looking for a Head of Total Reward to provide specialist leadership and hands-on delivery across compensation, benefits, job architecture, benchmarking and reward governance. Reporting to and working closely with the Fractional Head of People, you will play a key role in delivering GoGlobal's wider People transformation, bringing deep functional expertise to shape Reward solutions and support their implementation. This is a highly collaborative relationship. You will lead specialist Reward workstreams and day-to-day delivery, while working alongside the Fractional Head of People on major strategic programmes, organisation-wide decisions and Executive engagement. What you'll be responsible for · Partner closely with the Fractional Head of People to develop and deliver the Total Reward agenda within GoGlobal's overall People strategy and transformation roadmap. · Translate strategic People and business priorities into practical, scalable Reward solutions and implementation plans. · Provide deep Total Reward expertise, insight and recommendations to support decision-making by the Fractional Head of People and Executive Leadership Team. · Work closely with Fractional Hed of People, on the design and implementation of GoGlobal's global job architecture, grading, career levels and salary structures, taking hands on responsibility for the specialist reward work and implementation. · Establish and maintain a robust approach to external market benchmarking, providing data and recommendations to inform pay and workforce decisions. · Develop GoGlobal's reward and pay philosophy, in partnership with the Fractional Head of People, and translate this into practical policies, governance and decision-making frameworks. · Lead the operational delivery of the annual salary and compensation review, working closely with the Fractional Head of People, Finance and business leaders to ensure recommendations are commercially aligned and implemented accurately. · Lead GoGlobal's global employee benefits activity, including benefit design, market reviews, renewals, broker/provider relationships and cost effectiveness. · Establish effective payroll governance, controls, ownership and escalation processes and provide appropriate oversight of payroll delivery. · Support Fractional Head of People in providing specialist Reward activity relating to pay equity, EU Pay Transparency and emerging regulatory requirements, as part of the wider People transformation. · Provide specialist advice on compensation decisions including recruitment, promotions, internal moves and retention. · Develop Reward analytics, reporting and insights to support strategic workforce planning and Executive decision-making. · Identify Reward risks, opportunities and emerging priorities and bring clear recommendations to the Fractional Head of People. · Partner with Talent, HR Operations and other People colleagues to ensure Reward initiatives are integrated into the wider People agenda. · Take hands-on ownership for implementation and delivery within the Reward function while contributing directly to wider People transformation programmes led by the Fractional Head of People. Requirements What we're looking for You will be an experienced international Total Reward leader who combines strong functional expertise with a willingness to be hands-on. Proven experience building and scaling Total Reward capability in a fast moving, international organization. Ideally having created reward frameworks, job architecture, benchmarking and pay practices from the ground up rather than solely operating within established structures. Comfortable operating in a hands-on environment, able to move between strategic design and practical delivery. You will bring significant experience across compensation, job architecture, grading, market benchmarking, salary structures, annual pay reviews, global benefits and payroll governance, ideally within a complex, geographically dispersed organisation. You will have experience operating across multiple countries and be comfortable navigating different markets, currencies, regulatory requirements and approaches to pay transparency. You will be confident developing recommendations and challenging constructively, while being equally comfortable moving from strategy into detailed implementation and delivery. Critically, you will be a highly collaborative leader who enjoys working closely with a senior People leader. You will bring specialist depth and strong recommendations while operating within an integrated People model, partnering closely with the Fractional Head of People and other functional Heads to deliver shared business priorities. Comfortable working with imperfect data and building structure where little currently exists. Typically 10+ years experience in Total Reward, including experience operating at senior leadership level within an international fast moving organization. A relevant HR or Reward qualification is desirable; however, strong practical international Total Reward experience is more important than a specific qualification. Benefits OVERVIEW As a privately owned company, we are free from the pressures of venture capital or private equity investors demanding exponential growth in unreasonable time frames. Sometimes, things just take time to do well. In our business, delivering great results is a process - and we're committed to doing it right. We are not for sale. We believe that financial success is a natural outcome of our work, not the primary goal. Unlike many investors who view money as a goal, our focus is on long-term growth and sustainable success. We are a global team, built for those who want to go further. Here's what your career at GoGlobal looks like: A company small enough for your voice to be heard meaningfully, yet large enough to make a global impact Collaborating with a diverse, global and supportive team Built for the long-haul - no VC or PE pressure, just a focus on sustainable growth WHY WE ARE DIFFERENT We Make Growing Your Career Possible We operate with the benefits of a partnership without the complexities of a partnership. Our hybrid partnership-corporate model offers all employees the opportunity to become a partner, while maintaining a streamlined corporate structure so that decisions are made quickly We do not offer equity plans. As we are not for sale and are not chasing an exit, "stock options" hold little value in our business model. Instead, we provide opportunities for outstanding employees to make partner and share in the profits. We believe it's better to build lasting value than to chase a one-time payout We prioritize organic and sustainable growth. Expanding operations quickly by way of mergers and acquisitions might seem appealing, but the reality is integrating diverse cultures can be challenging. We're proud of our own culture and prefer to grow it our way We're global. We offer career opportunities across the world-whether it's new job roles or international locations English is our official language, but for many, it's our second language. We embrace this and find it rewarding communicating with colleagues from all over the world We are not a family. We operate more like a high-performing sports team where each individual's contribution is crucial to our collective success We keep things simple and collaborative. Our structure makes it easy for teams to work together across borders so we can serve our clients with global needs more effectively. Unlike big, siloed companies, we work seamlessly to handle international deals without the headaches of territorial ownership We believe in transparency and trust. Every month, we share our financials with the team so everyone knows where we stand and what's coming next. It's all about open communication, building trust and empowering every individual to be part of our journey. We don't tell you what to think - we provide the information you need to make your own informed decisions We believe flexibility drives success. Our company is built on trust, and that's why we embrace fully remote work, and hybrid options in some countries. Forget rigid office routines - it's old school! This flexibility fuels productivity, strengthens our workforce, and ensures we remain agile in a fast-changing world Ready to take the next step in your career with us? Apply now! **Kindly review the provided privacy notice ( LINK ) to gain a comprehensive understanding of our policies and practices governing the treatment of your Personal Data. By applying, you consent to background and reference checks, to the extent permissible by law.

review_candidates.description: ARE YOU READY TO SHAPE HOW GANNI COMES TO LIFE ACROSS EVERY PHYSICAL CUSTOMER TOUCHPOINT? WE ARE LOOKING FOR A COMMERCIAL, CREATIVE, AND HANDS-ON LEADER TO DRIVE OUR GLOBAL VISUAL MERCHANDISING STRATEGY. Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You As Head of Global Visual Merchandising, you will play a key role in bringing the GANNI brand to life across our global retail network. Acting as the bridge between Creative and Commercial, you will translate seasonal creative direction into visual merchandising concepts that strengthen the customer experience, support commercial performance, and ensure a consistent brand representation across all physical customer touchpoints. Working closely with Creative, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Marketing, and Product teams, you will develop global visual merchandising standards while supporting markets in delivering best-in-class execution. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution - project management, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement. Responsibilities ahead of you: Global Visual Merchandising Strategy Develop and continuously evolve GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy across all physical customer touchpoints. Translate seasonal creative direction into commercially effective visual merchandising concepts and execution. Act as the bridge between Creative and Commercial to ensure visual merchandising aligns with both brand identity and commercial priorities. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent execution across the business. Brand Representation & Customer Experience Develop global VM guidelines, seasonal playbooks, execution decks, and visual standards. Ensure consistent brand representation across Retail stores, Wholesale, Department Stores, Concessions, Showrooms, Pop-ups, and Events. Lead the visual merchandising direction for seasonal launches, campaigns, collaborations, and key commercial moments. Ensure VM standards are executed consistently across all markets while allowing relevant local adaptations. Create engaging customer experiences that support both the brand and commercial objectives. Commercial Performance Partner closely with Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, and Marketing to maximise commercial performance through visual merchandising. Use retail KPIs and commercial insights to continuously improve customer experience and sales performance. Support product sell-through through effective product presentation, storytelling, customer flow, and merchandising principles. Monitor store feedback and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Global VM Community & Capability Support and develop GANNI's global network of field Visual Merchandising resources and Retail VM Ambassadors. Develop training programmes, tools, and best practices that strengthen VM capabilities across markets. Coach regional VM resources and retail teams to ensure consistent execution. Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the global VM community. Showrooms & Physical Brand Experience Lead the visual merchandising strategy across global showrooms during seasonal sell-in periods. Ensure collections are presented in a commercially effective, inspiring, and customer-focused way. Cross-Functional Projects Lead global VM projects from concept through implementation. Support new store openings, refurbishments, showroom projects, retail concepts, and pop-up activations. Collaborate closely with Creative, Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, Product Development, and Retail Operations. Continuously identify opportunities to simplify VM processes and improve ways of working across markets. Must Have Requirements 5–8 years of experience within Visual Merchandising in fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail. Experience developing and implementing visual merchandising strategies across multiple markets and sales channels. Strong understanding of how visual merchandising influences customer behaviour, supports commercial performance, and creates a consistent customer experience. Experience creating global VM guidelines, seasonal toolkits, showroom concepts, and visual standards. Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across Creative and Commercial functions. Excellent project management and organisational skills. Strong communication and presentation skills. Fluent in English. Willingness to travel internationally. THE GANNI WAY We're looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial understanding and enjoys working across functions to bring ideas to life. You are a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys turning creative concepts into clear, practical solutions. You build strong relationships, communicate with confidence, and naturally collaborate across teams and markets. You have a curious mindset, continuously look for opportunities to improve, and understand how strong visual merchandising can strengthen both the customer experience and business performance. We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect) , Optimism (you never stand still, just dance!) , Authenticity (you march at your own beat!) , Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences). The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system! GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing VM team! WHAT ELSE? Based in Copenhagen. Global role with regular international travel. Opportunity to shape the future of GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy and execution across Retail, Wholesale, Showrooms, and other physical customer touchpoints. Lead and develop a global VM team while working closely with colleagues across Creative and Commercial functions. DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression. We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us. To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role. BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY! We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community. We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “ Apply for position ” button. MORE GANNI GOODIES You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. Besides our amazing and colorful new office facilities, we are also proud of our inhouse GANNI kitchen that offers healthy and sustainable food cooked by our passionate in-house chef.
